rows.help:
Project and task visibility
Control who can access this project:

• Internal users: choose whether access is limited to team members or available to everyone in your organization.
• Portal users: choose whether invited collaborators can access the project.

Access levels for portal users

• View: can access tasks and send messages.
• Edit: can create and update tasks.
• Advanced Edit: create and update tasks, change their priority, and move them between stages.

Other rules

• Internal users can open a task from a direct link, even if they don't have access to the project application.
• Project admins have access to private projects, even if they are not team members.
